newsitem.title: UK: Horlick had been promoted before suspension-source.
newsitem.headline: Horlick had been promoted before suspension-source.

text.p: Nicola Horlick, a pension fund head at Morgan Grenfell Asset Management, had been promoted to managing director days before her suspension on Tuesday, a banking source told Reuters on Thursday.
This followed news on Thursday that Horlick had resigned from Deutsche Morgan Grenfell, the investment banking arm of Germany's Deutsche Bank.
The source told Reuters that Horlick had received news of her promotion last Friday from Robert Smith, chief executive of Morgan Grenfell Asset Management (MGAM).
"They shook hands on it last Friday," the source said.
Horlick was suspended on Tuesday pending the outcome of an internal investigation into what Deutsche Morgan Grenfell described as "a potential breach of her contract".
A spokesman for Horlick told Reuters on Thursday that she would be taking legal action against her former employer over what she called her "constructive dismissal".
